scenes.name: home
lines: AI SEO Deck shows whether AI engines like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude and Grok recommend your brand.
Then it fixes your Webflow site where they don't.

scenes.name: deny
lines: Installing starts on Webflow's own authorization screen.
The app asks to read the user, sites, pages and CMS, and to write pages and CMS items. It writes only when you press Apply.
First, we deny access. AI SEO Deck shows that the authorization was cancelled, and it stores nothing.

scenes.name: approve
lines: Now we approve it, for the demo site only.
Webflow sends us back to AI SEO Deck. The access token is stored encrypted on our server and never reaches the browser.

scenes.name: overview
lines: The overview shows the AI visibility score: the share of AI answers that name the brand.
Next to it are the keywords to fix first, ranked by searches and by how rarely AI names you.

scenes.name: keywords
lines: Every keyword is asked as two real customer questions on ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Grok. Google AI Overviews and AI Mode get the search itself.
A yellow mark means the engine names you. A blue ring means it also links to your site.

scenes.name: answers
lines: For each keyword you see exactly what every engine said, which rivals it named, the searches it ran and the sites it cited.

scenes.name: fixplan
lines: The fix plan shows the current title and description, read live from Webflow, next to new ones written from the page.
It also writes answers to the questions behind the keyword, added to the page as FAQ schema.
Apply to Webflow writes them through the Webflow Data API on the primary locale, as unpublished changes.

scenes.name: designer
lines: AI SEO Deck also runs inside the Webflow Designer.
The panel identifies the user with a Webflow ID token. Our server resolves it and answers only for this site.
Write with AI drafts a title and description from the page. Apply to this page uses the Designer API, so the change shows at once.

scenes.name: publish
lines: Nothing goes live until you publish. Publishing in Webflow puts the fixes on the site.

scenes.name: account
lines: Free plan: 1 site, 3 keywords and 3 engines, checked every month.
Paid plans add every engine, weekly checks and one-click fixes, from $19 a month with a 7-day free trial.
You can disconnect Webflow or delete your account at any time.
